goal: A run parked AWAITING_APPROVAL lands its branch through the standard landing ladder on the pass that consumes its approve command, with no operator-issued git commands.

graders.name: lint
graders.run: uv run ruff check packages/flywheel-orchestrator packages/flywheel-worktree

relevant: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_orchestrate.py -- the reactive approval-resolve block (resolve_manual_approval call, ~lines 2582-2634) and _drive_under_lease's gate-evaluate + verdict-record + submit sequence (~lines 3320-3400) it must reuse; module is over 800 lines, use serena symbols
packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/harness.py -- resolve_manual_approval / ResolveApprovalOutcome (reasons incl. approved_done); read-only, module is over 800 lines, use serena symbols

packages/flywheel-worktree/src/flywheel_worktree/worker.py -- run_once wiring and GitWorktreeSubmitter._submit/_teardown_on_failure (where the AWAITING_APPROVAL worktree parks today); read-only reference, use serena symbols
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_steering_bridge.py -- the approve-command enqueue/consume harness pattern to mirror; keep green
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_redriver_human_gates.py -- keep green, assertions unmodified (the sweep must still never auto-approve)
packages/flywheel-worktree/tests/test_landing_record.py -- the real-git harness + recording-ledger pattern to mirror
references: docs/held-out-gate.md -- the gate runs between finalize and submit; the post-approval land must clear the same bar
constraints: The post-approval land reuses the existing held-out gate evaluation + verdict-record + strategy.submit path -- do not fork a second landing path; gate evaluation fails closed identically (D-2)
Only a resolution with reason approved_done lands; approved_next_gate, rejected_retry, rejected_failed, and no_pending_command behave byte-for-byte as today

The landing uses the branch/worktree preserved at park time and flows through the strategy's full ladder (FF, rebase + re-verify, and any recovery rungs present) -- never a blind FF and never a raw ref write
The behavior test drives the approve command through the sqlite store so this task stays independent of phase 12-postgres-control-plane
Commit the change (Conventional Commits) before reporting done
non_goals: Do not change resolve_manual_approval's lifecycle semantics in flywheel_core -- the harness owns transitions
Do not weaken, delete, or modify existing assertions in the pinned test files
No changes to approve/reject command consumption under the postgres store (phase 12 owns that)
Do not read or write under .flywheel/verification/
edge_cases: Criterion 5: the base ref advances to include the branch (git merge-base --is-ancestor exits 0) with grader/verify receipts recorded by the machinery, and the test issues no git commands of its own after enqueueing the approve
A base that advanced while the run awaited approval must route through the rebase/recovery rungs, not fail silently
Approval consumed but the parked worktree or branch is gone (retention destroyed it): the pass must not crash and must leave a queryable park/strand surface -- never a silent DONE-without-landing
A held-out gate that fails against the parked content suppresses the land and parks with the held-out-gate kind, exactly as on first-attempt landing
